_comment: The authored world: what can be observed, and the thoughts that come of it. Empty on purpose -- the shore is being authored from scratch. `config/psyche.placeholder.json` holds the old test content and is a reference for the authoring format (encounter shape, tiers, deeds, unlock_when clauses); it is NOT loaded. An encounter must author both halves -- something to observe AND something to do -- or it is dropped at load with a warning. Any text field may carry {player} -- it binds to the pilgrim's chosen name at world-enter. Tunable -- edit + relaunch (dev reads assets from source).

roll._comment: Tuning for the thought roll + reward scaling. Coefficients only; the math lives in C++ (see include/Psyche.h RollConfig).

_interact_reach_comment: World px from an encounter's box edge: get within this and it glows and can be observed. One knob for the whole game.

encounters._comment: the wake-up moment, fired by the wake scene (never placed). No speaker: the tier is HIS half-asleep read of the room, and the menu is the game's first decision -- a must_choose menu, so it repeats until a deed CONSUMES it. The turn-offs are the room's chores (each one_shot, each raising the flag its sound dies on); doing BOTH unlocks get_up. Hiding is always available -- and if he hides, Mom silences the room herself (mom_enters). This beat is the first stroke of who this Will is.

tiers.text: The alarm again. The TV downstairs, or maybe in the room. Morning has opinions.

add.label: Turn off the TV.
add.result_text: A reach, a button. The murmur stops mid-sentence.

add.label: Pull the covers over your head.
add.result_text: Warm. Dark. For a little while, no such thing as today.

encounters._comment: the alarm clock. Its loop rings until this deed sets alarm_off (leaving it on is a choice). Needs an Encounter placement on the clock in PlayerRoom.

tiers.text: The clock, mid-argument with the morning. It has been winning for a while.

encounters._comment: the TV. Its murmur runs until turn_off sets tv_off (the shutdown clunk fires on the same flag). Needs an Encounter placement on the TV in PlayerRoom.

tiers.text: Static, mostly. It kept somebody company all night.

add.label: Turn it off.
add.result_text: The picture folds into a point and is gone.

encounters._comment: the covers branch's exchange at the bedside, fired by the mom_enters scene AFTER her call through the door (the first_morning_call remark). trigger Enter + speaker = her voice, unprompted. The tier carries the beat's one job: the promise to Mr. Richards (the trail). Deeds are the player's replies; result lines are hers.
encounters.speaker: mom

tiers.text: You promised Mr. Richards you'd clear the trail in his backyard today. Up.

add.label: I'm up. I'm up.
add.result_text: Mm. The kettle's on. He's expecting you before it gets hot out.

add.label: Five more minutes.
add.result_text: You said that yesterday, and the day still came. Boots by the door.

encounters._comment: the slipped-out branch: her voice from downstairs when your door goes. Enter + speaker = spoken. The deed exists to satisfy the both-halves rule and as a future reply surface; it is unreachable outside the scene (no placement).
encounters.speaker: mom

tiers.text: {player}…? That you? -- Don't forget Mr. Richards. The trail. You promised.

add.label: Yeah -- I'm up.
add.result_text: Breakfast's out. Don't let it sit.

encounters._comment: shape is final, words are a first draft to rewrite. One encounter = the whole person; tiers are what HE notices (his voice), deeds are his moves, result_text is HER voice (speaker). The chain demonstrated: observe her -> a thought lands -> the thought's id unlocks a deed -> her reply sets a flag -> a second thought builds on both.
encounters.speaker: mom

tiers.text: She is at the counter, already dressed. The kettle has been on a while.
She moves like the kitchen is a place she is holding still. Everything wiped twice.

add.label: Say good morning
add.result_text: Morning. There's toast, if you'll actually eat this time.

add._comment: Unlocked by NOTICING, not by menu-grinding: the thought below must land first.
add.label: Ask if she slept
add.result_text: I sleep fine. You're the one leaving with half a plan -- sit, eat something.

thoughts._comment: Perception: noticing her, from observing her. Its id becomes a memory that unlocks the ask.
thoughts.text: She was up before the kettle. The tired sits on her like it lives here.
thoughts.miss_text: Something about the way she stands. It slips away.

thoughts._comment: Reason: fusing the noticing with her deflection. emotional_weight carries it -- it opens nothing, it just matters.
thoughts.text: She answers questions about herself by feeding people. That is the whole answer.
thoughts.miss_text: Her answer wasn't an answer, but you can't say what it was instead.

remarks._comment: her call through the bedroom door, played by the mom_enters scene BEFORE she enters -- reading it is what brings her in. No unlock_when: scene-only (nothing triggers it ambiently).
the game's first words, said into the pillow. Faculty-less so it always lands; remarks never reach the notebook.
